text:
vikram: Heads-up — customer #428 reported double-charge on stream reconnect + toolcall. Saw suffix tokens counted twice when client resumed. Trace: tr-9f8a, session=ephemeral-12345. logs: `CHUNK_SENT len=512 ack=0x7f reconnect=true fallback_route=region-b`

ashley: ugh. repro steps? which model, routing policy, and client SDK version?

vikram: model redwood/open-compat-2 (quantized). fallback happened after 504 from primary region, client retried with resume token. SDK v1.12. Example: client does streaming -> toolcall mid-stream, primary fails, reconnects to canary, server recomputed prefix and re-emitted last chunk. Toolcall metadata appears to create separate billing.

sam: sounds like we credit on confirmed ACKs but when fallback occurs we create a provisional session in new router and both sessions get billed for overlap. Need to tie session_id across handoff so ledger can dedupe provisional vs confirmed.

maria: two quick fixes: 1) server-side: require client to send original session_id in reconnect header and use it for idempotency; 2) console: show provisional vs confirmed token lines in request trace so customers can see what's provisional. also +1 to a fallback policy that trims duplicated suffix tokens.

pranav: GUI question — how would provisional tokens look in billing UI? proposal: faint dashed line for provisional tokens, hover explains 'may be refunded after reconciliation'. add a 'Reconcile' action for ops to force commit/refund. prototype: https://console/redwood/proto/provisional-billing

vikram: pasted router headers we saw: `x-session-id: ephemeral-12345`, `x-reconnect-token: rtk-87`. We currently set x-session-id on primary but don't always propagate it to fallback. Fixing propagation seems easiest.

ashley: can we add server-side dedupe using (session_id, suffix_hash) when provisional session overlaps? cheap approach: mark fallback tokens provisional with parent_session pointer; if original path later confirms, mark duplicates and refund.

sam: caveat: some clients intentionally create a new session on retry. policy: only dedupe if client included original session id header. otherwise treat as distinct request.

maria: @ops-bot can you create an incident? Reconcile script might need to run for this customer for the past 24h. please run `billing:reconcile --customer 428 --since 24h`

ops-bot: Incident created -> INC-2026. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/stream-reconcile. Reconcile job queued.

pranav: rollout notes: add console flag `show_provisional_charges` default off. emit telemetry event when provisional created: event=provisional_charge_created reason=fallback tag=region-b trace=tr-9f8a

vikram: will open PRs: router -> propagate x-session-id; ledger -> mark provisional tokens with parent_session + dedupe pass; telemetry -> emit provisional events. I'll ping infra for a quick canary.

ashley: assign owners: Vikram -> router PR, Sam -> ledger dedupe algo, Maria -> console mockup, Pranav -> telemetry + UI flag. I'll coordinate QA and a postmortem doc. :thumbsup:
